description: Cartographie des lignes électriques is a dataset listed in Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement de Corse. Cartographie des lignes électriques issue de la BD CARTO. Coverage: Corsica. Its keywords are données ouvertes, ligne, électricité, énergie, équipement, réseau. The portal shows 173 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2003-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-oddc-datacorsica-portal.
